title: MD Review

purpose.en: Review every .md document of the project: keep it, condense it or discard it. Your decisions are queued for Claude; nothing is deleted from this screen.
purpose.id: Tinjau setiap dokumen .md proyek: pertahankan, ringkas, atau buang. Keputusan Anda diantre untuk Claude; tidak ada yang dihapus dari layar ini.

keywords: md review, review md, berkas md, dokumen usang, ringkas dokumen, buang dokumen, markdown, tinjauan berkas

steps.en: Open MD Review. Each row is one document with Claude's proposal and the reason.
steps.id: Buka MD Review. Tiap baris satu dokumen beserta usulan Claude dan alasannya.

steps.en: Use the boxes on top or Search to narrow the list, for example Proposed discard.
steps.id: Pakai kotak di atas atau Search untuk menyaring daftar, misalnya Proposed discard.

steps.en: Pick Keep, Condense or Discard in the Decision column. Each choice is saved at once with your name and the time.
steps.id: Pilih Keep, Condense atau Discard di kolom Decision. Tiap pilihan langsung tersimpan dengan nama dan waktu Anda.

steps.en: Click Process with Claude in the header. Claude reads the queue at the start of a session and applies the decisions; you approve the result.
steps.id: Klik Process with Claude di header. Claude membaca antrean di awal sesi dan menerapkan keputusan; Anda menyetujui hasilnya.

fields.label: File
fields.en: Path of the document in the repository.

fields.label: Proposal
fields.en: Claude's suggestion: Keep, Condense, Unsure or Discard.
fields.id: Saran Claude: Keep, Condense, Unsure atau Discard.

fields.label: Decision
fields.en: Your choice: Keep, Condense or Discard. Empty means not decided yet.
fields.id: Pilihan Anda: Keep, Condense atau Discard. Kosong berarti belum diputuskan.

fields.label: Lines
fields.en: Number of lines of the document.

fields.label: Last changed
fields.en: Date of the last commit that changed the document.
fields.id: Tanggal commit terakhir yang mengubah dokumen.

fields.label: References
fields.en: How many other files mention this document by name.
fields.id: Berapa berkas lain yang menyebut nama dokumen ini.

title: Old Stories Review

purpose.en: Review your own earlier messages about the ERP and mark which ones are your story to adopt into the documents. Decisions are queued for Claude.
purpose.id: Tinjau pesan-pesan lama Anda tentang ERP dan tandai mana yang cerita Anda untuk diadopsi ke dokumen. Keputusan diantre untuk Claude.

keywords: cerita lama, old stories, review cerita, pesan lama, riwayat sesi, adopsi cerita, keputusan lama

steps.en: Open Old Stories Review. The Decide tab lists each message with its date and the start of the text.
steps.id: Buka Old Stories Review. Tab Decide menampilkan tiap pesan dengan tanggal dan awal teksnya.

steps.en: Open the Full text tab to read a whole message, or use Search to find a word.
steps.id: Buka tab Full text untuk membaca pesan utuh, atau pakai Search untuk mencari kata.

steps.en: Pick Adopt (this is my story), Later or Ignore in the Decision column. Each choice is saved at once.
steps.id: Pilih Adopt (ini cerita saya), Later atau Ignore di kolom Decision. Tiap pilihan langsung tersimpan.

steps.en: Click Process with Claude in the header. Claude writes the adopted stories into the right document and you approve the result.
steps.id: Klik Process with Claude di header. Claude menulis cerita yang diadopsi ke dokumen yang benar dan Anda menyetujui hasilnya.

fields.label: Decision
fields.en: Your choice: Adopt, Later or Ignore. Empty means not decided yet.
fields.id: Pilihan Anda: Adopt, Later atau Ignore. Kosong berarti belum diputuskan.

fields.label: Message
fields.en: The first part of the message. The Full text tab shows all of it.
fields.id: Bagian awal pesan. Tab Full text menampilkan seluruhnya.

fields.label: Session
fields.en: Short reference of the session the message came from.

fields.label: Characters
fields.en: Length of the message in characters.
